notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (cpu-basic/upgrade partitions; hardware capacity matching, not strict CPU/RAM enforcement), Harbor 271f0a31, with the published fast-agent-mcp[ptc] 0.10.53 wheel, programmatic tool calling on (ptc=on in the model string): every tool call went through the exec_sandbox Python code tool. Kimi K3.1 Pro (high reasoning) through Hugging Face Inference Providers, routed to Together. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply.

64 infrastructure failures were rerun as replacements: 63 trials stopped after Together returned HTTP 429 through all of fast-agent's provider retries (61 of them in one 30-minute rate-limit storm at the end of the run) and one sandbox error. Every trial that failed this way was replaced, whatever its outcome; 57 of the replacements passed. The originals are kept as evidence; the run as first launched scored 336/445.

Cost is Harbor's recorded cost at the cohort's configured rates (card-packs pricing catalog 2026-11-05.1, rule kimi-k3.1-pro-hf-together: $2.00 / $0.20 / $10.00 per million input / cached / output tokens). 31 reported trials have model calls that failed with HTTP 429 and reported no usage, so the total is a lower bound.
